C0197.title: Tampermonkey Script for Bulk Unfollowing on Weibo
C0197.summary: A Zhihu article introduces a Tampermonkey-based script designed to automate bulk unfollowing on Weibo. While Weibo offers a native bulk unfollow feature, it requires manual selection of each account, prompting the author to develop this script for efficiently cleaning up the following list.

references.title: Weibo Batch Unfollow - Chrome Web Store
